headline: Samsung and SK Hynix report surge in profits amid high memory chip demand
summary: South Korean chipmakers Samsung and SK Hynix reported profit increases of 738% and 632% respectively. Demand for memory chips remains high, with supply reportedly nearly sold out through 2029.
why: Samsung and SK Hynix are the world's dominant manufacturers of memory chips, which are essential components for smartphones, data centers, and AI hardware.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Record profits and high demand signal a robust cycle for the global memory chip industry.
